title: Low-Dose CT Images of Healthy Cohort (Healthy-Total-Body-CTs)
citation: Selfridge, A., Spencer, B., Shiyam Sundar, L., Abdelhafez, Y., Nardo, L., Cherry, S., Badawi, R. (2023). Low-Dose CT Images of Healthy Cohort (Healthy-Total-Body-CTs) (Version 3) [dataset]. The Cancer Imaging Archive. https://doi.org/10.7937/nc7z-4f76
provenance: TCIA describes 30 healthy adult participants; segmentation masks were automatically generated at the 90-minute timepoint using MOOSE. The archive contains segmentation NIfTI files and the label-value workbook. This ingestion excludes the separate 58.95 GB DICOM CT download, which is governed by NIH Controlled Data Access Policy.
evidence_boundary: Cohort source-mask inventory only. It does not bind these participants to Numi's current mechanical subject, establish expert-reviewed segmentation accuracy, reconstruct skin, provide arterial/venous lumens, calibrate tissue material, or qualify physiology, mechanics, or clinical use.
